preprocessing_current_code.waveform: Decode native sample rate, retain selected channel0; all acquired sources here are mono. No upsampling to claim additional observed bands.
preprocessing_current_code.bands: 25 base10 deci-decade centres c_j=10^(1.5+0.1*j), j=0..24. Integrate bins c/10^0.05 <= f < c*10^0.05 using sum(PSD)*df.
preprocessing_current_code.Nyquist_gate: Every upper band edge must be <= native_fs/2; otherwise reject rather than fill unsupported bands.
preprocessing_current_code.minute_mean: Only complete30-block groups form a measured1min row by linear band-power mean. Average power before dB; do not average dB.
preprocessing_current_code.tails: Discard only incomplete<2s waveform tail at segment conversion. Remaining complete2s blocks that do not finish a measured minute stay in the segment bank.
preprocessing_current_code.units: Uncalibrated digital mean-square band power. Different hardware transfer functions remain a domain limitation.
preprocessing_current_code.short_under60: Produces zero measured-minute rows but retains complete2s segments. NativeFirstSampler inserts the measured sequence once onto a450-block controlled added-component support and averages30blocks/minute.
preprocessing_current_code.short_support_semantics: Zero outside the once-placed added component is an explicit synthetic support choice, not an assertion that unobserved natural audio was silent. Placement may crop an event edge; no repetition, cycling or interpolation creates fictitious observations.
preprocessing_current_code.native_at_least900: Crop an actual contiguous450-block15min sequence from the measured reference.
preprocessing_current_code.level_normalization: One scalar digital normalization of a reference preserves its observed time/frequency energy ratios; alpha is solved from known components under the actual observed-cell mask.
preprocessing_current_code.target: y=sum(O*alpha*R)/sum(O*(B+alpha*R)); q=alpha*R/(B+alpha*R). R includes measured ambient sound, so y is controlled added-reference share, not verified natural vessel-only share.
preprocessing_current_code.native_probability_caution: Default0.5 applies to each reference-pool choice before corpus/group/clip hierarchy and fallback; it is not a promise that exactly50% of synthetic examples are independent native sources.
